question: Does the only stable q<1 signal from the strong sweep reflect within-island NDVI targeting, an island-allocation effect, or a simpler occurrence-conditioned allocation rule?

decision.within_island_ndvi: q10 support must beat same-allocation environment-free coverage with bootstrap lower95>0 and sign-flip p<0.05
decision.ndvi_allocation: q10 support may retain between-island environmental value only if it beats equal-one-per-island and the best training-occurrence allocation with the same stability gate
decision.occurrence_policy: a training-occurrence allocation survives only if it beats global max coverage with bootstrap lower95>0 and sign-flip p<0.05

hard_boundaries: No search over q/K/r in this decomposition.
No within-island environmental ranking beyond the already frozen q10 eligibility mask.
Frozen 192 Practical Core cohort remains untouched.
